prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Paint the supplied paint_mask_guide.png, with design_reference.png as detail/material reference and icon_x8.png as original colour reference (magenta is background only).
Output ONE transparent PNG, 1536x2048 or nearest 3:4 size. Preserve the guide's entire canvas, all object positions, sizes, exact silhouettes and gaps. This is a texture projection atlas, NOT a presentation sheet. Three columns and FOUR rows of equal cells. Rows 1-2 show five views FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty, exactly as the grey guide. Rows 3-4 repeat these same five views as material masks. Respect the actual guide: the first row shows narrow edge-on strips; the second row has an edge-on strip on left, and the broad pendant with its chain in the middle. Do not turn edge-on strips into full face views. Keep column 3 rows 2 and 4 entirely transparent.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: Paint grey objects only with unlit base colour of the upright Green Man pendant: aged golden bronze with muted moss/olive green patina, leafy face, leaf veins, engravings and scrollwork faithful to design reference and game icon, scaled to the visible surfaces of each view. Chain and bail are aged golden bronze. No lighting, AO, cast shadows, hot highlights or reflections. Preserve exact guide geometry; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign objects.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: Each silhouette filled with FLAT pure colours only: #FF0000 every metal part including bronze/gold pendant and chain, #000000 every gemstone/crystal/glass/pearl/enamel/liquid, #0000FF every cloth/cord/ribbon/hair. The foliage is sculpted patinated metal, not real leaves or hair. Every silhouette pixel gets one of these colours, with no shading, texture, outlines or antialiased interior colour blends. Nothing outside silhouettes.
Keep every gap, chain hole and opening exactly as the guide and fully transparent. No ground, text, grid lines, labels, aura, sparkle or extra objects. Preserve the guide alpha and alignment.
CORRECTION PRIORITY: Previous attempt distorted the lower mask chain holes and added stray red pixels. Use the ORIGINAL grey guide as an immutable silhouette stencil for every view. Lower two rows must be EXACT duplicates of guide alpha, uniformly pure red on this entirely metal object. Preserve each individual chain link and transparent hole, no filled chain interiors, no stray pixels or speckles around masks. Keep the identical placement and full 3:4 canvas. Upper paint should be matte unlit base colour, without shaded relief lighting.
